jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Moon Active is one of the world's fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We're looking for a talented DevOps Engineer to join our team. As a DevOps Engineer, you will architect and operate scalable, resilient cloud environments, using advanced automation and AI-based tools to improve system health, reduce manual intervention, and optimize infrastructure costs.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle of the Coin Master platform. Ensure high availability, performance, and cost-efficiency across our multi-region AWS environment.

  • Design and maintain robust, high-performance infrastructure using IaC. You will focus on building self-healing environments where AI agents continuously monitor and remediate issues in real-time.

  • Embed security into the infrastructure layer. Leverage AI-assisted tooling to proactively identify and patch vulnerabilities across our Kubernetes clusters and AWS stack.

  • Build tools and services that empower our engineering team to ship code faster. You are the architect of the platform, ensuring it is intuitive, scalable, and fully automated.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of DevOps experience. Proven track record in managing production-ready Kubernetes clusters, AWS infrastructure, and high-traffic distributed systems.

  • Experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows, including hands-on use of AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) for infrastructure automation, planning, and debugging.

  • Extensive management experience of multiple AWS accounts spanning various regions, proficient in services like Lambda, CloudFront, SQS, VPC, and IAM.

  • Strong understanding of cloud cost optimization at scale through architectural design and automated resource management.

  • Deep proficiency with modern CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD).

Advantages

  • Experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph) or building internal tools/agents that interact with cloud APIs to automate operational tasks.

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (MSK/Apache Kafka) and high-performance caching layers like Redis/Elasticache.

  • Experience with CloudFlare management and complex edge-computing configurations.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Moon Active is one of the world's fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer who is passionate about cutting-edge technology to play a significant role in the development of new, AI-powered applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop innovative, state-of-the-art, AI applications and products.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for AI-driven applications.

  • Lead and own projects from ideation to production.

  • Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your code contributes directly to our growth and efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a software developer.

  • B.Sc./M.Sc.in Computer Science or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Typescript or Go.

  • Deep understanding in modern architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding and development workflows.

  • Strong fluency with front-end development and user experience.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML APIs, context engineering, or orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain) is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Moon Active is one of the worlds fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv. 

Were looking for an experienced and extremely motivated Product Manager to join our growing Product team. Are you charismatic, super assertive and have no problem taking ownership? Then this could be the perfect fit for you!

As a Product Manager, you'll get the chance to make a direct impact on millions of players from around the world, help scale our product strategy and the success of our games features. You'll also have a great impact on the company's business performance.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the success and growth of the product by developing a product vision, strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management framework and seek opportunities for key initiatives to improve the customer experience

  • Gather and analyze requirements, write clear and detailed PRDs, UI/UX flows, wireframes, define A/B tests and user stories, prioritize backlogs and handle development/engineering

  • Own the success of the feature once its released to production by running tests and optimising performance and business results

  • Collaborate with relevant cross-functional teams (R&D, Design, BI/BA, etc) to guarantee a smooth, and efficient implementation.


Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience as a Product Manager. 

  • Adapts well to a dynamic and rapidly changing work environment. 

  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with a high attention to detail. 

  • Exceptional communication skills and can clearly convey messages in English (written and oral).

  • Excellent collaboration skills and can work effectively with and influence other teammates.

  • Problem solver and a creative thinker that can provide insightful and innovative solutions to any problem. 

  • Team player, a people person and truly enjoys working with multiple teams. 

  • Strong passion for mobile games - Advantage

jobs.title: Unity Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Moon Active is one of the worlds fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We are looking for an experienced Unity Developer with an AI-first mindset to build next-gen gaming features. You will join a team of engineers building high-scale, real-time game systems, leveraging LLMs for complex logic, automating workflows, and using AI agents to continuously improve how we build.

Responsibilities

  • Manage features from system design and data handling to production deployment.

  • Design architectures and implement end-to-end client-side features, leveraging LLMs from day-to-day development processes up to system architecture.

  • Use data-driven methods to resolve production issues and optimize performance across all devices.

  • Manage the integration of native plugins and third-party services.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software development.

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor or similar.

  • Experience with object-oriented programming, including design patterns, algorithms, and data structures. 

  • Strong knowledge of an OOP language (C# or equivalent) and memory management.

  • Proactive, self-driven, with strong communication skills.

  • Experience with Unity on mobile platforms, including its scripting APIs, profiling tools, UI, and animations.

Advantages

  • AI engineering - Experience in building agentic & autonomous frameworks.

  • Experience working in a high scale data driven environment - firebase, analytics, metrics etc.

jobs.title: Technical Artist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Moon Active is one of the world’s fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We’re looking for a motivated and ambitious Technical Artist to join our rapidly growing Art & Design team. As a Technical Artist, you’ll work closely with our Creative, Product and Development teams to shape Moon Active games.

 

Responsibilities

  • Integrate creative assets (art and visual effects) into the game.

  • Investigate and implement new techniques and practices.

  • Optimize workflow processes using tools, scripts and AI so each teammate can focus on their core contribution.

  • Contribute to technical solutions and pipeline design for the production and delivery of art assets and help leverage our technology.

  • Be responsible for creating a smooth pipeline for designs and assets incorporating significant amounts of 2D elements.

Requirements

  • Portfolio - Must

  • Knowledge in 2D animation, Unity and Photoshop.

  • Experience in Unity or ability to undergo Unity training.

  • Proven track record of both artistic and technical creativity with a passion for solving problems.

Advantage

  • Knowledge of AI tool development and scripting in Unity.
